svg.title: Engraved sea: Copperplate engraving
svg.desc: The Engraved Sea (2D): a side-scrolling run across a copperplate sea. Alexi's small sloop surfs down the face of a crest he has just raised by stirring at the reticle behind him; a revenue cutter gives chase from the trough, its grapnel line falling short. Above, the chart strip shows his course inked to the pin, and the coast strip shows boats lifting at their moorings.
